reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 17 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Nets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 89 times in 100, by about 15; most games like this end between 198 and 246 total points.
